source_provenance: Source commit is the starting checkout; source_input_sha256 and in-image byte attestation identify the actual tested uncommitted inputs recorded by the feature PR.

scope.hosts: two privileged DinD hosts with independent daemons and storage on one physical PC
scope.online_services: uid 10001; no parent Docker socket or offline root/backup-key mounts
scope.database: CA state only; remote_apply synchronous physical standby; explicit fenced promotion
scope.control_plane: single trusted surviving witness, vault and leaf controller; no consensus or whole-site recovery

newline_provenance: Raw Windows working-tree bytes were copied to the attested Docker image. The LF-normalized hashes bind these inputs to Git text blobs across checkout newline normalization.

preliminary_unit_timeouts_excluded.failure: Existing 20-second child-process timeout during overlapping work; unchanged test passed on serial full reruns.

limits: Two service-host failure domains simulated on one PC; physical PC/kernel/Docker Desktop and trusted control plane remain shared.
Explicit fencing/promotion; no automatic partition election or consensus.
Cold restore is tested after a writer-stop seal with admission still closed; unsealed/unknown post-seal writes block restore.
Single measured restore, includes fresh daemons and local image loading; no production RTO/RPO or availability SLA.
CA state only; no application SQLite migration/restore, whole-site PKI loss recovery, HSM or external antirollback anchor.
